name: MCP Demo Stack
description: A demo team that bundles MCP servers — install it, enable it in this project, and its MCP servers appear in Settings → MCP under From teams.
longDescription: Shows how a team can ship MCP servers. It declares two MCP servers in its own mcp.json: a local SQLite-backed memory server (stdio) and a remote HTTP placeholder (http). Installing this team at app level and enabling it in a project makes both servers available to chats in that project; disabling the team greys them out and stops injection.
